Inherited glomerular basement-membrane disease; hearing loss is only 5-29% in this dominant subtype, and ocular lesions are uncommon.

The factor-deficiency designation and bleeding phenotype support a hereditary hemostatic disorder; molecular details are unspecified.

Localized plasma-cell neoplasm; destructive osseous tumors account for roughly 70-80% of cases; upper-airway tumors are a minority across the whole group.
Congenital atrial septal malformation; the other reported structural and conduction abnormalities remain cardiovascular.
